jobs.title: Forex Exposure & Special Projects Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Are you ready to make a global impact in Treasury and Corporate Finance? We are looking for an experienced Treasury and Financial Risk Management professional to lead global Forex exposure reporting and support strategic corporate finance initiatives. In this role, you will strengthen global financial risk reporting, governance, and treasury-related processes while supporting funding, capital structure, and strategic transaction activities across a complex international business environment. How you'll make an impact Lead and continuously improve global FX and commodity exposure reporting standards. Harmonize exposure reporting and governance across Treasury, Finance, and Global Business Units. Enhance reporting frameworks in line with company policies and financial risk management standards. Support complex projects involving hedging strategies, multi-currency cash flow planning, and treasury risk management. Drive effective use of S\/4HANA, Treasury Management Systems, and reporting tools to monitor exposures. Ensure strong governance, internal controls, and adherence to treasury best practices. Develop reporting dashboards, KPIs, and training programs for global stakeholders. Contribute to strategic corporate finance initiatives, including funding projects and M&A activities. Your background Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Treasury, or a related field. Professional treasury or finance certification (e.g., ACT, CTP, CFA) is a plus. 10+ years of experience in Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Corporate Finance, or related areas. Strong knowledge of FX exposure management, hedging instruments, commodity risk, liquidity, and treasury governance. Experience with ERP and treasury systems, ideally including S\/4HANA and Treasury Management Systems. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex topics into actionable insights. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in an international environment. Fluent English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Sei pronto a fare un impatto globale nel settore del Tesoro e delle finanze aziendali? Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista esperto di gestione del Tesoro e del rischio finanziario per guidare la segnalazione globale di esposizione Forex e sostenere iniziative strategiche di finanza aziendale. In questo ruolo, rafforzerai la reportistica finanziaria globale dei rischi, la governance e i processi legati al tesoro, supportando al contempo finanziamenti, struttura dei capitali e attività di transazione strategica in un complesso ambiente aziendale internazionale. Come farete un impatto Piombo e migliorare continuamente gli standard globali di reporting FX e di esposizione delle merci. Armonizzare la segnalazione e la governance dell'esposizione attraverso il Tesoro, le Finanze e le Global Business Units. Migliorare i framework di reporting in linea con le politiche aziendali e gli standard di gestione dei rischi finanziari. Sostenere progetti complessi che coinvolgono strategie di copertura, pianificazione del flusso di cassa multivaluta e gestione del rischio tesoreria. Utilizzare efficacemente S\/4HANA, Sistemi di Gestione del Tesoro e strumenti di reportistica per monitorare le esposizioni. Assicurare una forte governance, controlli interni e l'adesione alle migliori pratiche del tesoro. Sviluppare dashboard di report, KPI e programmi di formazione per gli stakeholder globali. Contribuisci a iniziative strategiche di finanza aziendale, inclusi progetti di finanziamento e attività M&A. La tua laurea in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration, Contabilità, Tesoro, o un campo relativo. La certificazione professionale di tesoreria o finanza (ad esempio, ACT, CTP, CFA) è un plus. 10+ anni di esperienza in tesoreria, gestione del rischio finanziario, finanza aziendale o aree correlate. Forte conoscenza della gestione dell'esposizione FX, strumenti di copertura, rischio di merce, liquidità e governance del tesoro. Esperienza con sistemi ERP e tesoreria, idealmente compresi S\/4HANA e Sistemi di gestione del Tesoro. Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in insights attuabili. Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder in un ambiente internazionale. Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, eine globale Wirkung in Treasury und Corporate Finance zu erzielen? Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Finanz- und Finanzrisikomanagement-Experten, der die globale Forex-Exposure-Berichterstattung leitet und strategische Unternehmensfinanzierungsinitiativen unterstützt. In dieser Rolle stärken Sie globale Finanzrisikoberichterstattung, Governance und Treasury-bezogene Prozesse und unterstützen Finanzierungs-, Kapitalstruktur- und strategische Transaktionsaktivitäten in einem komplexen internationalen Geschäftsumfeld. Wie Sie Einfluss nehmen und die globalen FX- und Commodity Exposure Reporting Standards kontinuierlich verbessern. Harmonisierung von Exposure Reporting und Governance in Treasury, Finance und Global Business Units. Verbesserung des Berichtsrahmens im Einklang mit den Unternehmenspolitiken und den Standards für das Finanzrisikomanagement. Unterstützen Sie komplexe Projekte mit Hedging-Strategien, Multi-Währungs-Cashflow-Planung und Treasury-Risikomanagement. Treiben Sie den effektiven Einsatz von S\/4HANA, Treasury Management Systemen und Reporting-Tools zur Überwachung von Expositionen voran. Gewährleistung einer starken Governance, internen Kontrollen und Einhaltung der Best Practices des Treasury. Entwicklung von Reporting-Dashboards, KPIs und Schulungsprogrammen für globale Stakeholder. Beitrag zu strategischen Unternehmensfinanzierungsinitiativen, einschließlich Finanzierungsprojekten und M&A-Aktivitäten. Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Buchhaltung, Treasury oder einem verwandten Bereich. Professionelle Treasury- oder Finanzzertifizierung (z.B. ACT, CTP, CFA) ist ein Plus. 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Corporate Finance oder verwandten Bereichen. Fundierte Kenntnisse des FX-Exposure-Managements, der Sicherungsinstrumente, des Rohstoffrisikos, der Liquidität und der Treasury-Governance. Erfahrung mit ERP- und Treasury-Systemen, idealerweise einschließlich S\/4HANA und Treasury Management Systems. Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen. Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld. fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen gelten als Vorteil.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à avoir un impact mondial sur le Trésor et les Finances? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel expérimenté de la gestion des risques financiers et de la trésorerie qui dirigera l'établissement de rapports sur l'exposition globale au Forex et soutiendra les initiatives stratégiques de financement des entreprises. Dans ce rôle, vous renforcerez l'information sur les risques financiers mondiaux, la gouvernance et les processus liés à la trésorerie tout en appuyant les activités de financement, la structure des immobilisations et les opérations stratégiques dans un environnement commercial international complexe. Comment vous allez faire un impact Le plomb et améliorer continuellement les normes mondiales de déclaration de l'exposition aux FX et aux matières premières. Harmoniser les rapports d'exposition et la gouvernance entre les unités du Trésor, des Finances et des Affaires mondiales. Améliorer les cadres de rapport conformément aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux normes de gestion des risques financiers. Appuyer des projets complexes comprenant des stratégies de couverture, la planification des flux de trésorerie multidevises et la gestion des risques de trésorerie. Encourager l'utilisation efficace de S\/4HANA, des systèmes de gestion de la trésorerie et des outils de déclaration pour surveiller les expositions. Assurer une gouvernance solide, des contrôles internes et le respect des pratiques exemplaires en matière de trésorerie. Élaborer des tableaux de bord, des ICR et des programmes de formation pour les intervenants mondiaux. Contribuer aux initiatives stratégiques de financement de l'entreprise, y compris les projets de financement et les activités de fusion-acquisition. Votre formation Diplôme en finance, économie, administration des affaires, comptabilité, Trésorerie, ou un domaine connexe. La certification professionnelle de trésorerie ou de finance (p. ex., ACT, CTP, FCA) est un plus. 10 ans et plus d'expérience en Trésorerie, gestion des risques financiers, finances générales ou domaines connexes. Connaissance approfondie de la gestion des expositions FX, des instruments de couverture, du risque de produits de base, de la liquidité et de la gouvernance de la trésorerie. Expérience des systèmes ERP et de trésorerie, incluant idéalement les systèmes S\/4HANA et de gestion de la trésorerie. Des compétences analytiques solides avec la capacité de traduire des sujets complexes en idées pratiques. Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication dans un environnement international. Anglais fluent; les langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un avantage.

jobs.title: Wartungstechniker/in Fertigungsanlagen 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In unserem Werk BiMOS Backend in Lenzburg stellen wir effiziente und hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorensteuerungen und Wechselrichtersystemen her. Damit leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag, die Industrie, den öffentlichen und individuellen Verkehr energieeffizienter zu gestalten und andererseits ermöglicht unsere Technologie das Produzieren und Transportieren von erneuerbaren Energien vom Produktionsstandort hin zum Verbraucher. Werde Teil der Energiewende und unterstütze uns, die Verfügbarkeit unserer Fertigungsanlagen zu erhalten und verbessern. Das kannst du bewirken Geplante Instandhaltung, Wartung und Inspektion: Regelmässige und zustandsabhängige Massnahmen zur Vermeidung von Ausfallzeiten und Sicherung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durchführen gemäss allgemeinen Vorgaben, spezifischer Instandhaltungsanweisung, Dokumentation von Abweichungen und Planung der Leitung Instandhaltung Kalibrierung von Anlagen und Komponenten: Sicherstellung der präzisen Funktionsfähigkeit von Systemen zur Maximierung der Produktionsqualität und -leistung Verwaltung von Ersatz- und Verbrauchsmaterialien: Optimierte Materialbewirtschaftung für eine reibungslose Produktion Proaktive Informationsweitergabe: Laufende Berichterstattung über durchgeführte Arbeiten zur Unterstützung einer effizienten Planung und Umsetzung Qualitätskontrolle: Nachhaltige Inspektion der (selbst) durchgeführten Wartungsarbeiten sowie Anlagen- und Prozessfreigaben mittels Funktionstests und statistischer Prozesskontrolle (SPC) um höchste Produktionsstandards sicherzustellen Schulung des Personals: Weiterbildung der Schichtmitarbeiter im technischen Bereich, um Wissen zu teilen und Prozesssicherheit zu gewährleisten Technische Dokumentation: Dokumentation der durchgeführten Instandhaltungsarbeiten und Identifikation von Abweichungen in Wartungs- und Arbeitsunterlagen zu deren Verbesserung Sicherstellung der Arbeitssicherheit: Einhaltung und Überwachung von Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutzrichtlinien zur Gewährleistung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfeldes Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung EFZ oder EBA im technisch-mechanischen Bereich Erfahrung im Bereich Instandhaltung, idealerweise in einem automatisierten Umfeld Zuverlässige, gründliche und effiziente Arbeitsweise nach Vorgabe und Anweisung zur nachhaltigen Umsetzung der präventiven Instandhaltungsarbeiten Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen geplanten Sondereinsätzen Bereitschaft zur eigenen kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Schulung Deutsch mindestens C1, Englisch mindestens A2 Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Nel nostro impianto BiMOS Backend di Lenzburg, produciamo semiconduttori di potenza efficienti e di alta qualità per l'uso nei sistemi di controllo motori e nei sistemi di inverter. In questo modo, forniamo un contributo decisivo per rendere più efficiente l'industria, il trasporto pubblico e individuale e, d'altra parte, la nostra tecnologia consente la produzione e il trasporto di energie rinnovabili dal sito produttivo al consumatore. Entrate a far parte della transizione energetica e sosteneteci nel mantenere e migliorare la disponibilità delle nostre strutture produttive. È possibile raggiungere questo Piano di Manutenzione, Manutenzione e Ispezione: misure regolari e dipendenti dalle condizioni per evitare i tempi di fermo e garantire la disponibilità degli impianti eseguire secondo specifiche generali, specifiche istruzioni di manutenzione, documentazione di deviazioni e pianificazione della gestione Calibrazione di impianti e componenti: Garantire la precisa funzionalità dei sistemi per massimizzare la qualità e le prestazioni della produzione Gestione dei materiali sostitutivi e di consumo: Gestione del materiale ottimizzata per una produzione liscia Gestione trasferimento di informazioni proattive: Resocontazione continua dei lavori effettuati per sostenere una pianificazione efficiente e l'implementazione Controllo qualità: Controllo sostenibile dei lavori di manutenzione e rilascio di impianti e processi mediante test funzionali e controllo dei processi statistici (SPC) per garantire i più elevati standard di produzione Formazione del personale: ulteriore formazione dei dipendenti nell'area tecnica per condividere le conoscenze e garantire la sicurezza dei processi Documentazione tecnica: Documentazione dei lavori di manutenzione e identificazione delle deviazioni nei documenti di manutenzione e di lavoro per migliorare la loro sicurezza di manutenzione: Compliance e monitoraggio delle linee guida per la sicurezza, la salute e la tutela dell'ambiente Questo si porta con formazione professionale completa EFZ o EBA nell'area tecnico-meccanica Esperienza nel campo della manutenzione, ideale Con noi, si può aspettare un posto di lavoro sicuro in una società orientata al futuro, emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e apprezzativo e benefici sociali attraenti.
descriptionByLocale.en: At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, we manufacture efficient and high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control systems and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and individual transport more energy efficient and, on the other hand, our technology enables the production and transport of renewable energies from the production site to the consumer. Become part of the energy transition and support us in maintaining and improving the availability of our production facilities. You can achieve this Planned Maintenance, Maintenance and Inspection: Regular and condition-dependent measures to avoid downtime and ensure plant availability carry out according to general specifications, specific maintenance instructions, documentation of deviations and planning of the management Calibration of plants and components: Ensuring the precise functionality of systems for maximizing production quality and performance Management of replacement and consumable materials: Optimized material management for a smooth production Management Proactive information transfer: Ongoing reporting of work carried out to support efficient planning and implementation Quality control: Sustainable inspection of the (self) carried out maintenance work as well as plant and process releases by means of functional tests and statistical process control (SPC) to ensure the highest production standards Training of the staff: further training of the employees in the technical area to share knowledge and ensure process safety Technical documentation: Documentation of the carried out maintenance work and identification of deviations in maintenance and work documents to improve their maintenance safety: Compliance and monitoring of safety, health and environmental protection guidelines to ensure a safe working environment This you bring with completed vocational training EFZ or EBA in the technical-mechanical area Experience in the field of maintenance, ideal With us, you can expect a secure workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and appreciative working environment and attractive social benefits.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Dans notre usine de Lenzburg, nous fabriquons des semi-conducteurs de puissance efficaces et de haute qualité pour des systèmes de commande de moteurs et d'onduleurs. De cette manière, nous contribuons de manière décisive à rendre l'industrie, les transports publics et individuels plus économes en énergie et, d'autre part, notre technologie permet la production et le transport des énergies renouvelables du site de production au consommateur. Participez à la transition énergétique et aidez-nous à maintenir et à améliorer la disponibilité de nos installations de production. Vous pouvez réaliser ce plan d'entretien, d'entretien et d'inspection : Mesures régulières et dépendantes des conditions pour éviter les temps d'arrêt et assurer la disponibilité de l'usine effectuer selon les spécifications générales, les instructions d'entretien spécifiques, la documentation des écarts et la planification de la gestion Étalonnage des installations et des composants : Assurer la fonctionnalité précise des systèmes pour maximiser la qualité et les performances de production Gestion des matériaux de remplacement et consommables : Gestion optimisée des matériaux pour une production fluide Gestion Transfert d'information proactive : Rapports continus sur les travaux effectués pour appuyer une planification et une mise en oeuvre efficaces Contrôle de la qualité : inspection durable de l'auto-entretien ainsi que des rejets d'usines et de procédés au moyen d'essais fonctionnels et d'un contrôle statistique des procédés (SPC) pour assurer les normes de production les plus élevées Formation du personnel : formation continue des employés dans le domaine technique pour partager les connaissances et assurer la sécurité des procédés Documentation technique : Documentation des travaux d'entretien et identification des écarts dans les documents d'entretien et de travail pour améliorer leur sécurité d'entretien: Respect et surveillance des lignes directrices en matière de sécurité, de santé et de protection de l'environnement pour assurer un environnement de travail sûr Ce que vous apportez avec la formation professionnelle complète EFZ ou EBA dans le domaine technique-mécanique Expérience dans le domaine de l'entretien, idéal Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un lieu de travail sécurisé dans une entreprise orientée vers l'avenir, des opportunités de développement passionnant, un environnement de travail collégial et appréciateur et des avantages sociaux attrayants.

jobs.title: Financial Planning Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a Financial Planning Lead to own and continuously enhance the financial planning and forecasting agenda. This role partners closely with the CFO, Head of FP&A, and senior leadership to translate business strategy into robust financial plans, actionable insights, and clear performance narratives. The successful candidate will lead and develop the team responsible for budget and forecast cycles, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency, business partnering, and the practical application of technology, automation, and AI to modernize planning processes. This position can be performed remotely within Europe. Please submit your application documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and a clear articulation of key assumptions, risks, opportunities, and business drivers. Partner with Finance Leadership to deliver strategic analysis, scenario modelling, and high-quality executive deliverables that support business decisions and external communications. Build strong relationships with business units and functional finance teams to understand business needs, strengthen data quality, and provide relevant insights that improve decision-making. Act as a key liaison with Headquarters in Tokyo, providing timely reporting, clear communication, and well-structured responses to inquiries to support alignment on performance, strategy, and priorities. Manage, develop, and coach the planning team to deliver high-quality outputs efficiently while building strong technical, analytical, business partnering, and continuous improvement capabilities. Support strategic initiatives with robust financial analysis, clear recommendations, and commercially relevant insights. Bring hands-on experience applying AI in financial planning, such as driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, anomaly detection, predictive insights, workflow automation, and  management reporting. Own relevant FP&A applications in close collaboration with IT, ensuring tools are fit for purpose, well governed, and effectively adopted by users. Identify, design, and implement automation and process improvement opportunities that enhance the speed, accuracy, transparency, and insightfulness of planning and forecasting outputs. Champion the adoption and optimization of planning, forecasting, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to support modern, agile, and forward-looking finance processes. Your background Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline; MBA or professional finance qualification (CFA, CPA, CIMA) preferred. 10+ years of experience in FP&A, including deep involvement in planning, forecasting, and performance management in complex, global organizations. Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams to deliver accurate and insightful outputs efficiently. Strong technical proficiency in planning systems, data visualization tools, and modern finance technology platforms. Hands-on experience using AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics to improve planning quality, forecasting accuracy, scenario modelling, decision support, or reporting efficiency. Demonstrated ability to drive process automation, digital transformation, and technology-enabled improvements in finance. Exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, and commitment to high standards. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate financial data into clear insights and influence senior stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow

jobs.title: PMO Lead - Legal & Integrity Operations 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a PMO Lead who helps teams move faster, stay focused, and make better decisions. This role supports the Legal & Integrity transformation portfolio by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to important initiatives.  You will work closely with Legal, Integrity, Legal Operations Service Center, Legal Tech Lead, IS, AI teams, and external partners. Your job is to turn business needs into clear plans, connect the right people, and help initiatives land with measurable impact.  The PMO is not an administrative control function. It is a lean enablement function that helps teams execute well, remove blockers, and keep leadership informed.  How you'll make an impact  Keep one clear view of the transformation portfolio, including priorities, milestones, risks, and decisions  Help teams define simple plans with clear ownership, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria  Track progress, spot blockers early, and drive follow-through on actions and commitments  Prepare decision-ready updates for leadership, steering committees, and portfolio governance forums  Translate legal and operational needs into structured business and technical requirements  Act as a bridge between Legal, Integrity, Legal Tech, IS, AI teams, and vendors.   Support AI and legal tech initiatives by helping define use-cases, scope, requirements, and measurable outcomes  Use modern tools such as Microsoft 365, Loop, Power BI, and Copilot to reduce manual work and improve visibility    Your background  A bachelor's degree in business, technology, operations, project management, or a related field and equivalent practical experience   Approximately 5–10 years' experience in a multinational environment  Strong experience in project, program, or portfolio management  A practical, outcome-focused mindset and the ability to turn strategy into execution  Good business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and problem framing  Confidence working with senior stakeholders, project sponsors, technical teams, and external partners  Strong communication skills, especially the ability to simplify complex topics  Comfort working across business and technology teams  Experience with tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Teams, Loop, Copilot or similar collaboration and reporting tools  Interest in using AI to improve delivery, reporting, and ways of working  Fluency in English (communication with stakeholders on senior\/executive levels)    More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition. Joining our Legal & Integrity Operations team offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a transformation portfolio that drives efficiency, innovation, and collaboration across a global organization. You will work in a dynamic environment where continuous improvement, digital solutions, and AI-enabled ways of working are shaping the future of how we operate.

jobs.title: Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data management, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that portfolio decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights. The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders. 
• We offer flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with time spent in the office. How you'll make an impact Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team. Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control. Raise purchase orders and verify invoices Prepare presentation materials, analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division's intranet presence Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities Your background Proven experience in real estate data management, analysis, and reporting. Experience in lease management. Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function. Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data. Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform. Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset. Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment. More about us Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams. The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified: Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary  Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Siamo alla ricerca di un Analista Portfolio Immobiliare Aziendale altamente analitico e orientato ai dettagli, per supportare la gestione efficace del nostro portafoglio immobiliare globale. Questo ruolo combina gestione dei dati, gestione dei contratti di locazione, reporting e coordinamento interfunzionale per garantire che le decisioni sul portafoglio siano supportate da informazioni accurate e approfondimenti significativi.

Il candidato ideale ha esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale, gestione dei dati immobiliari, gestione delle locazioni, analisi basate su Excel, strumenti di collaborazione come Teams e SharePoint, e nella preparazione di presentazioni di alta qualità per gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili, inclusa la possibilità di lavorare in modalità ibrida, combinando lavoro da remoto e presenza in ufficio.

Come avrai un impatto
Gestisci e migliora continuamente i dati del portafoglio in Archibus, inclusi proprietà, contratti di locazione, pianificazione strategica e informazioni sulla sostenibilità.
Sviluppa una forte competenza nelle funzionalità di Archibus e promuovi il loro uso efficace all’interno del team.
Fornisci formazione su Archibus e supporto agli utenti interni.
Lavora a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni per raccogliere, validare e consolidare i dati del portafoglio in modo tempestivo e affidabile.
Supervisiona il nostro fornitore esterno responsabile dell’amministrazione delle locazioni e garantisce l’accuratezza, completezza e coerenza dei dati di locazione.
Identifica e migliora i processi relativi alla raccolta, validazione, astrazione delle locazioni e gestione delle locazioni per aumentare efficienza e controllo.
Gestisci ordini di acquisto e verifica le fatture.
Prepara materiali di presentazione, analisi, report e grafici utilizzando molteplici fonti di dati e strumenti.
Traduci dati complessi sul settore immobiliare in approfondimenti chiari che supportano le decisioni sul portafoglio e il reporting di gestione.
Organizza e mantiene i siti Teams e SharePoint e supporta lo sviluppo della presenza intranet della divisione.
Contribuisci al funzionamento fluido ed efficiente della divisione di Gestione del Portfolio Globale attraverso attività di supporto amministrativo.

Il tuo background
Esperienza comprovata nella gestione, analisi e reporting di dati immobiliari.
Esperienza nella gestione delle locazioni.
Esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale all’interno di una funzione immobiliare globale aziendale.
Capacità di interpretare i termini di locazione, comprendere le strutture del portafoglio e i dati immobiliari.
Esperienza pratica con piattaforme di gestione dati immobiliari.
Eccellente competenza in Excel, Power BI e SharePoint.
Conoscenza di SAP REFX è un plus.
Forti capacità analitiche, creatività e approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi.
Alta organizzazione, rigore, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di lavorare con precisione in un ambiente in rapido cambiamento.
Capacità di gestire più priorità contemporaneamente e lavorare efficacemente su diversi argomenti.
Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese, con capacità di collaborare con successo in un ambiente di team globale.

Maggiori informazioni su di noi
Hitachi Energy Real Estate fornisce leadership strategica per le attività immobiliari globali, agendo come partner commerciale per migliorare le performance attraverso soluzioni efficaci.
Il divisione Global Portfolio Management definisce strategie, mitiga rischi e utilizza approfondimenti basati sui dati per migliorare le performance del portafoglio.
Supporta inoltre le tematiche di sostenibilità immobiliare in collaborazione con le Business Unit e i team di sostenibilità di Hitachi Energy.

Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione nella località (Italia) specificata:
A partire da: 44.800 € lordo annuo
Contratto collettivo applicabile: Metalmeccanico
L’offerta finale sarà basata sulla posizione del candidato, competenze, qualifiche, esperienza e in linea con le strutture salariali interne.

Questa posizione è aperta in Francia, Germania, Svizzera, Italia e Spagna.
Se le informazioni sul salario elencate non sono applicabili alla tua attuale residenza, i dettagli salariali rilevanti per la tua località verranno discussi in un secondo momento.

La nostra offerta di benefit è personalizzata in base al paese di impiego e generalmente include:

You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! jobs.title: Research Scientist - Complex Systems Modelling for Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact   System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation:  Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support:  Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership  Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation:  Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

L'Opportunità
Entra a far parte di Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e svolgi un ruolo chiave nel promuovere una forte cultura della salute, della sicurezza e dell'ambiente all'interno delle nostre operazioni di fabbrica a Zurigo. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con la leadership e i team interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, ridurre al minimo i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE, supportando al contempo operazioni sostenibili e sicure.

Come avrai un impatto
- Garantire la conformità alle normative HSE, alle politiche interne e agli standard Hitachi Energy in tutta la fabbrica
- Condurre valutazioni dei rischi, audit e ispezioni per identificare i pericoli e definire le azioni di mitigazione
- Guidare le indagini sugli incidenti e attuare misure correttive e preventive efficaci
- Monitorare i KPI HSE, preparare report e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati
- Fornire e coordinare sessioni di formazione HSE promuovendo al contempo la consapevolezza e le migliori pratiche
- Supportare gli audit interni, esterni e di certificazione, garantendo azioni di follow-up tempestive
- Collaborare con team interfunzionali e stakeholder esterni per integrare l'HSE nelle operazioni quotidiane
- Guidare iniziative HSE e programmi di miglioramento ambientale (ad es. Rifiuti, acqua, energia)

Il tuo background
- Minimo 5 anni di esperienza HSE in ambiente industriale o energetico
- Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze Ambientali, Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro, o campo simile
- Professionista HSE certificato secondo la legislazione svizzera (obbligatorio)
- Buona conoscenza delle norme ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 e HSE

jobs.title: CDSe Domain Expert – Liquid and Dry Transformers
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We are currently seeking a skilled and highly motivated candidate to join our CDSe (Common Design System Electrical) team as a CDSe Domain Expert for Liquid and Dry Transformers. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of the distribution transformer electrical design platform , ensuring it meets the highest standards of performance, reliability, and efficiency. How You'll Make An Impact Support CDSe development and maintenance by aligning with technical standards and technological advancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement new features. Prepare software specifications, collaborate with developers on implementation, and verify the accuracy of implemented features.Develop test cases to ensure the sustainable quality of the CDS platform and lead test sessions with end users. Conduct thorough testing and validation of the design platform to ensure accuracy and reliability.Perform comparative analysis of calculated and tested transformer parameters, identify root causes of discrepancies, and propose effective solutions. Provide technical support, prepare training materials, and deliver training sessions to end users.Monitor hotline requests and act on user feedback to improve the platform's performance.Work closely with Hub Engineering teams to accelerate CDS implementation in factories. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies and incorporate them into the platform. Be part of a multicultural, globally distributed CDS community and propose innovative solutions. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in the design of dry-type or liquid transformers. Strong knowledge of design principles, materials, manufacturing, and testing of transformers.Awareness of different transformer technologies. Experience in or interest in software development (e.g., macro development, Excel automation tools). Proactive, self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership.Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills & Ability to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary team. Strong communication skills, with good verbal and written English proficiency. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us in work and out.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo sta avanzando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Portiamo il potere nelle nostre case, scuole, ospedali e fabbriche. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale per le nostre comunità e la società. Porta la tua passione, porta la tua energia e fai parte di un team globale che apprezza una semplice verità: diversità + collaborazione = grande innovazione. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un candidato qualificato e altamente motivato per aderire al nostro team CDSe (Common Design System Electric) come esperto di dominio CDSe per trasformatori liquidi e a secco. Il candidato di successo svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nello sviluppo e nella valorizzazione della piattaforma di progettazione elettrica del trasformatore di distribuzione, assicurando che soddisfi i più elevati standard di prestazioni, affidabilità ed efficienza. Come farete un supporto d'impatto sviluppo e manutenzione CDSe allineando con standard tecnici e progressi tecnologici. Collabora con team interfunzionali per raccogliere requisiti, soluzioni di progettazione e implementare nuove funzionalità. Preparare le specifiche del software, collaborare con gli sviluppatori sull'implementazione e verificare l'accuratezza delle funzionalità implementate. Sviluppare casi di test per garantire la qualità sostenibile della piattaforma CDS e sessioni di test con gli utenti finali. Condurre test approfonditi e validazione della piattaforma di progettazione per garantire precisione e affidabilità. Eseguire l'analisi comparativa dei parametri di trasformatore calcolati e testati, identificare le cause di root delle discrepanze e proporre soluzioni efficaci. Fornire supporto tecnico, preparare materiali di formazione e fornire sessioni di formazione per gli utenti finali. Monitorare le richieste di hotline e agire sul feedback degli utenti per migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma. Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Hub Engineering per accelerare l'implementazione di CDS nelle fabbriche. Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del settore e sulle tecnologie emergenti e incorporale nella piattaforma. Partecipa a una comunità di CDS multiculturale e distribuita a livello mondiale e propone soluzioni innovative. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative esterne e interne applicabili, procedure e linee guida. La tua laurea di primo livello o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo correlato. Provata esperienza nella progettazione di trasformatori a secco o liquido. Forte conoscenza dei principi di progettazione, materiali, produzione e test dei trasformatori. Consapevolezza delle diverse tecnologie del trasformatore. Esperienza o interesse nello sviluppo del software (ad esempio, sviluppo macro, strumenti di automazione di Excel). Proattivo, automotivato, con un forte senso di proprietà. Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze & Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di un team multidisciplinare. Forte capacità di comunicazione, con buona padronanza inglese verbale e scritta. Siamo orgogliosi di offrire una gamma olistica di programmi di beneficio competitivo per sostenere il vostro benessere finanziario, fisico e mentale e lo sviluppo personale. Vogliamo che tu prosperi veramente con noi nel lavoro e fuori.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Hitachi Energy ist es unser Ziel, eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle voranzutreiben. Wir bringen Energie in unsere Häuser, Schulen, Krankenhäuser und Fabriken. Begleiten Sie uns und arbeiten Sie mit fantastischen Menschen zusammen, während Sie lernen und sich an Projekten entwickeln, die einen echten Einfluss auf unsere Gemeinschaften und die Gesellschaft haben. Bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft ein, bringen Sie Ihre Energie ein und werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das eine einfache Wahrheit zu schätzen weiß: Vielfalt + Zusammenarbeit = Große Innovation. Wir suchen derzeit einen qualifizierten und hoch motivierten Kandidaten, der unserem CDSe-Team (Common Design System Electrical) als CDSe Domain Expert für flüssige und trockene Transformatoren beitritt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Verbesserung der elektrischen Konstruktionsplattform für Verteiltransformatoren spielen und sicherstellen, dass sie die höchsten Standards in Bezug auf Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz erfüllt. How You'll Make An Impact unterstützt die Entwicklung und Wartung von CDSe durch die Anpassung an technische Standards und technologische Fortschritte. Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um
• Anforderungen zu sammeln, Lösungen zu entwerfen und neue Funktionen zu implementieren. Bereiten Sie Softwarespezifikationen vor, arbeiten Sie mit Entwicklern bei der Implementierung zusammen und überprüfen Sie die Genauigkeit der implementierten Funktionen. Entwicklung von Testfällen, um die nachhaltige Qualität der CDS-Plattform zu gewährleisten und Testsitzungen mit Endbenutzern zu leiten. Durchführung gründlicher Tests und Validierungen der Designplattform, um Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten. Führen Sie eine vergleichende Analyse der berechneten und getesteten Transformatorparameter durch, identifizieren Sie die Ursachen von Abweichungen und schlagen Sie effektive Lösungen vor. Bereitstellung von technischem Support, Vorbereitung von Schulungsmaterialien und Durchführung von Schulungen für Endbenutzer. Überwachen Sie Hotline-Anfragen und handeln Sie auf Benutzerfeedback, um die Leistung der Plattform zu verbessern. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Hub Engineering-Teams zusammen, um die Implementierung von CDS in Fabriken zu beschleunigen. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit Branchentrends und neuen Technologien und integrieren Sie sie in die Plattform. Werden Sie Teil einer multikulturellen, global verteilten CDS-Community und schlagen Sie innovative Lösungen vor. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten Bereich. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Trocken- oder Flüssigkeitstransformatoren. Ein fundiertes Wissen über Konstruktionsprinzipien, Materialien, Herstellung und Prüfung von Transformatoren. Bewusstsein für verschiedene Transformatortechnologien. Erfahrung oder Interesse an Softwareentwicklung (z. B. Makroentwicklung, Excel-Automatisierungstools). Proaktiv, selbstmotiviert, mit einem starken Gefühl von Besitz. Hervorragende analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, unabhängig und in einem multidisziplinären Team zu arbeiten. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit guten verbalen und schriftlichen Englischkenntnissen. Wir sind stolz darauf, eine ganzheitliche Palette von Wettbewerbsvorteilen anzubieten, um Ihr finanzielles, körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden und Ihre persönliche Entwicklung zu unterstützen. Wir möchten, dass Sie wirklich mit uns in der Arbeit und draußen gedeihen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy, notre objectif est de faire progresser un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Nous apportons le pouvoir à nos maisons, écoles, hôpitaux et usines. Rejoignez-nous et travaillez avec des gens fantastiques, tout en apprenant et en vous développant sur des projets qui ont un impact réel sur nos communautés et notre société. Apportez votre passion, apportez votre énergie et faites partie d'une équipe mondiale qui apprécie une simple vérité : Diversité + Collaboration = Grande Innovation. Nous recherchons actuellement un candidat qualifié et très motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe CDSe (Common Design System Electrical) en tant qu'expert de domaine CDSe pour les transformateurs liquides et secs. Le candidat retenu jouera un rôle crucial dans le développement et l'amélioration de la plate-forme de conception électrique du transformateur de distribution, en s'assurant qu'il répond aux plus hauts standards de performance, de fiabilité et d'efficacité. Comment vous ferez un impact Soutenir le développement et la maintenance des CDSe en s'aligneant sur les normes techniques et les progrès technologiques. Collaborez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour rassembler les exigences, concevoir des solutions et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités. Préparer les spécifications du logiciel, collaborer avec les développeurs sur la mise en œuvre, et vérifier l'exactitude des fonctionnalités mises en œuvre. Élaborer des cas d'essai pour assurer la qualité durable de la plate-forme du CDS et des séances d'essai avec les utilisateurs finaux. Effectuer des essais approfondis et la validation de la plate-forme de conception pour assurer la précision et la fiabilité. Effectuer une analyse comparative des paramètres du transformateur calculés et testés, identifier les causes profondes des écarts et proposer des solutions efficaces. Fournir un soutien technique, préparer du matériel de formation et offrir des séances de formation aux utilisateurs finaux. Surveiller les demandes d'assistance téléphonique et agir sur la rétroaction des utilisateurs pour améliorer les performances de la plateforme. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de Hub Engineering pour accélérer la mise en œuvre du CDS dans les usines. Restez informé des tendances de l'industrie et des technologies émergentes et intégrez-les à la plateforme. Faites partie d'une communauté multiculturelle et distribuée à l'échelle mondiale et proposez des solutions novatrices. Responsable de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe. Expérience éprouvée dans la conception de transformateurs de type sec ou liquide. jobs.description:
The opportunity In our Semiconductors business unit in Lenzburg, we develop and produce high-performance state of the art semiconductors power module for applications in different fields like rail transportation, power transmission, renewable energy, eMobility and more. the duration of the internship is 6 - 9 months. jobs.title: Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in power electronics and power grid applications to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions for a wide range of fast-growing applications like HVDC, energy storage systems and renewables like wind or solar. jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​ Competitive salary and incentives​ Well-being and care ​ Paid and unpaid leave​ Flexible work options ​ Benefits that support your financial security​ You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nell'ambito del nostro continuo viaggio di trasformazione digitale, stiamo sviluppando ACE, una piattaforma generativa AI all'avanguardia progettata per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza del nostro processo di Bid & Propost Management all'interno della Transformers Business Unit.
• Stiamo cercando un Prompt Engineer che svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale in questa iniziativa. Questo individuo sarà responsabile per la progettazione, il test e l'ottimizzazione dei prompt specifici di dominio che consentono ACE di generare output accurati, contestuali e business-aligned. Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dell'industria dei trasformatori, degli standard di attrezzature industriali e della comprensione di base delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche e del comportamento del modello GenAI, assicurando che ACE offre risposte di alta qualità su misura per scenari aziendali complessi. Il candidato ideale lavorerà a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT, gli esperti di materia principale, le parti interessate di business e i proprietari di moduli per abbattere la logica aziendale complessa in richieste specifiche per il dominio. Come farete un impatto Sviluppare, perfezionare e mantenere librerie rapide per varie unità di trasformatori\/fattori. Implementare tecniche avanzate come la catena rapida, l'iniezione di contesto, e l'apprendimento di pochi colpi per la precisione di livello enterprise. Gestione del proprio ciclo di vita rapido tra cui la versione, tracciabilità e governance. Valuta le risposte LLM per la precisione, la conformità e la mitigazione dei pregiudizi. Condurre test A\/B e mantenere le dashboard delle prestazioni per una rapida efficacia. Lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di moduli, gli esperti di materia principale del soggetto e gli stakeholder aziendali per incorporare i suggerimenti nei flussi di lavoro ACE. Creare una documentazione chiara per le strategie rapide e mantenere le migliori pratiche allineate con la Carta Etica AI di Hitachi Energy. Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti di GenAI per migliorare le capacità ACE. Implementare e consigliare le migliori pratiche per richiedere diversi moduli ACE. Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica Esperienza di lavoro nell'industria del trasformatore, con gli standard internazionali e la documentazione del cliente. Forte problem-solving e pensiero analitico. Forte ragionamento linguistico e logico per la realizzazione di precisi suggerimenti. Forte comprensione di NLP, gestione del contesto e ottimizzazione dei token. Capacità di sperimentare e iterare per ottimizzare gli output. Capacità di comprendere i processi aziendali e tradurli in richieste specifiche ACE. Esperienza pratica con LLM e tecniche ingegneristiche rapide. Forte interesse per le soluzioni aziendali AI. Volontà di imparare Python ed esperienza con i servizi AI APIs. Capacità di lavorare in ambienti Agile e gestire più stakeholder. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione. Mindset analitico con attenzione ai dettagli. Empatia per gli utenti finali e curiosità per la sperimentazione. Impegno alle pratiche etiche dell'IA e all'apprendimento continuo. Riduzione del tasso di guasto rapido e allucinazione del modello. Miglioramento della precisione delle uscite per moduli. Velocità e scalabilità dell'implementazione rapida tra i moduli ACE all'interno del Transformer Business Unit. Rispetto degli standard di governance e sicurezza AI. A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. Il nostro pacchetto benefici è progettato per aiutare i dipendenti a prosperare sia al lavoro che nella loro vita personale. La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include: Competitività e incentivi Benessere e cura congedo pagato e non pagato Opzioni di lavoro flessibili Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Im Rahmen unserer laufenden digitalen Transformation entwickeln wir ACE, eine hochmoderne Generative AI-basierte Plattform, die die Effizienz und Genauigkeit unseres Bid & Proposal Management-Prozesses innerhalb der Transformers Business Unit verbessern soll. Wir suchen einen Prompt Engineer, der eine zentrale Rolle in dieser Initiative spielen wird. Diese Person wird für das Entwerfen, Testen und Optimieren domänenspezifischer Eingabeaufforderungen verantwortlich sein, die es ACE ermöglichen, genaue, kontextbezogene und geschäftsorientierte Ergebnisse zu generieren. Die Rolle erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der Transformatorenindustrie, Industrieausrüstungsstandards sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis der prompten technischen Best Practices und des GenAI-Modellverhaltens, um sicherzustellen, dass ACE qualitativ hochwertige Antworten liefert, die auf komplexe Geschäftsszenarien zugeschnitten sind. Der ideale Kandidat wird eng mit IT-Experten, Subject Matter Experts, Business Stakeholdern und Modulbesitzern zusammenarbeiten, um komplexe Geschäftslogik in domänenspezifische Eingabeaufforderungen zu zerlegen. Wie Sie Einfluss haben Entwickeln, verfeinern und pflegen Sie prompte Bibliotheken für verschiedene Transformatoreinheiten / Fabriken. Implementieren Sie fortschrittliche Techniken wie prompte Verkettung, Kontextinjektion und Little-Shot-Learning für Genauigkeit auf Unternehmensebene. Eigenes promptes Lifecycle-Management einschließlich Versionierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Governance. Bewerten Sie LLM-Antworten auf Präzision, Compliance und Bias-Abschwächung. Führen Sie A\/B-Tests durch und pflegen Sie Performance-Dashboards für eine sofortige Effektivität. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Modulbesitzern, Fachexperten und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen, um Eingabeaufforderungen in ACE-Workflows einzubetten. Erstellen Sie eine klare Dokumentation für schnelle Strategien und pflegen Sie Best Practices, die mit der KI-Ethikcharta von Hitachi Energy in Einklang stehen. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue GenAI-Technologien, Frameworks und Tools, um die ACE-Fähigkeiten zu verbessern. Implementieren und empfehlen Sie Best Practices für Aufforderungen in verschiedenen ACE-Modulen. Ihr Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik Erfahrung in der Transformatorenindustrie mit internationalen Standards und Kundendokumentation. Starkes Problemlösen und analytisches Denken. Starke linguistische und logische Gründe für die Erstellung präziser Eingabeaufforderungen. Starkes Verständnis von NLP, Kontextmanagement und Tokenoptimierung. Fähigkeit zum Experimentieren und Iterieren, um Outputs zu optimieren. Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen und sie in ACE-spezifische Aufforderungen zu übersetzen. Hands-on Erfahrung mit LLMs und prompt Engineering-Techniken. Starkes Interesse an KI Enterprise-Grade-Lösungen. Bereitschaft, Python zu lernen und Erfahrungen mit KI-APIs-Diensten zu sammeln. Fähigkeit, in agilen Umgebungen zu arbeiten und mehrere Stakeholder zu verwalten. Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten. Analytische Denkweise mit Liebe zum Detail. Empathie für Endbenutzer und Neugier auf Experimente. Engagement für ethische KI-Praktiken und kontinuierliches Lernen. Reduzierung der prompten Ausfallrate und der Modellhalluzination. Verbesserung der Genauigkeit der Ausgaben durch Module. Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit der schnellen Bereitstellung über ACE-Module innerhalb der Transformer Business Unit hinweg. Einhaltung von AI Governance- und Sicherheitsstandards. Bei Hitachi Energy erkennen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Mittelpunkt unseres Erfolgs stehen. Wir verpflichten uns, einen unterstützenden und integrativen Arbeitsplatz, wettbewerbsfähige Belohnungen und Möglichkeiten für berufliches und persönliches Wachstum zu bieten. Unser Leistungspaket wurde entwickelt, um Mitarbeitern zu helfen, sowohl bei der Arbeit als auch in ihrem persönlichen Leben erfolgreich zu sein. Unser Leistungsangebot ist auf Ihr Beschäftigungsland zugeschnitten und umfasst in der Regel: Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Anreize Wohlbefinden und Pflege Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub Flexible Arbeitsoptionen Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen Sie erhalten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses spezifischere Informationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation numérique en cours, nous développons ACE, une plate-forme à la fine pointe de la technologie de l'intelligence artificielle conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'exactitude de notre processus de gestion des soumissions et des propositions au sein de l'unité opérationnelle Transformers. Nous cherchons un ingénieur rapide qui jouera un rôle central dans cette initiative. Cette personne sera responsable de la conception, de l'essai et de l'optimisation d'invites spécifiques au domaine qui permettent à ACE de générer des extrants précis, adaptés au contexte et adaptés aux activités. Le rôle exige une compréhension approfondie de l'industrie des transformateurs, des normes en matière d'équipement industriel ainsi qu'une compréhension de base des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie rapides et du comportement du modèle GenAI, en veillant à ce qu'ACE fournisse des réponses de haute qualité adaptées à des scénarios d'affaires complexes. Le candidat idéal collaborera étroitement avec les experts en TI, les experts en la matière, les intervenants en affaires et les propriétaires de modules afin de ventiler la logique opérationnelle complexe en indicateurs spécifiques au domaine. Comment vous allez faire un impact Développez, raffinez et maintenez des bibliothèques rapides pour différentes unités de transformateur\/usines. Mettre en œuvre des techniques avancées comme l'enchaînement rapide, l'injection de contexte et l'apprentissage à faible impact pour la précision de l'entreprise. Gestion rapide du cycle de vie, y compris la version, la traçabilité et la gouvernance. Évaluer les réponses à la LLM pour déterminer la précision, la conformité et l'atténuation des biais. Effectuer des essais A\/B et maintenir des tableaux de bord de performance pour une efficacité rapide. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de modules, les experts en la matière et les intervenants commerciaux pour intégrer les invites dans les workflows ACE. Créer une documentation claire pour des stratégies rapides et maintenir les meilleures pratiques alignées sur la Charte d'éthique de l'IA d'Hitachi Energy. Restez au courant des nouvelles technologies, cadres et outils de l'IAGG pour améliorer les capacités de l'ACE. Mettre en œuvre et recommander des pratiques exemplaires pour encourager l'adoption de différents modules ACE. Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique Expérience de travail dans l'industrie des transformateurs, avec des normes internationales et la documentation client. La résolution de problèmes et la pensée analytique. Fort raisonnement linguistique et logique pour élaborer des instructions précises. Une bonne compréhension du NLP, de la gestion du contexte et de l'optimisation des jetons. Capacité d'expérimenter et d'optimiser les sorties. Capacité de comprendre les processus opérationnels et de les traduire dans des instructions spécifiques à l'ACE. Expérience pratique des LLM et des techniques d'ingénierie rapides. Fort intérêt pour les solutions de qualité d'entreprise d'IA. Volonté d'apprendre Python et expérience avec les services API AI. Capacité de travailler dans des environnements agiles et de gérer plusieurs intervenants. Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration. Un état d'esprit analytique avec attention au détail. Empathie pour les utilisateurs finaux et curiosité pour l'expérimentation. Engagement envers les pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA et l'apprentissage continu. Réduction du taux de défaillance rapide et du modèle d'hallucination. Amélioration de la précision des produits par modules. Vitesse et évolutivité du déploiement rapide dans les modules ACE au sein de l'unité de transformation. Conformité aux normes de gouvernance et de sécurité de l'IA. Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, nous reconnaissons que notre peuple est au cœur de notre succès. Nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail favorable et inclusif, des récompenses concurrentielles et des possibilités de croissance professionnelle et personnelle. Notre trousse de prestations est conçue pour aider les employés à prospérer au travail et dans leur vie personnelle. Notre offre de prestations est adaptée à votre pays d'emploi et comprend généralement: Salaire concurrentiel et incitations Bien-être et soins Congés payés et non payés Options de travail flexibles Avantages qui soutiennent votre sécurité financière Vous recevrez des informations plus précises pendant le processus de recrutement.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Test Engineer – SiC/Si 80–100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, where we ensure the highest quality and reliability standards for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules.   Our products play a critical role in enabling renewable energy, eMobility, traction, and industrial applications worldwide. As we continue to expand our testing capabilities, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Senior R&D Test Engineer to support the development and qualification of innovative Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) technologies. In this role, you will work at the interface of R&D, product engineering, and testing, helping bring advanced semiconductor technologies from development to industrialization.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to the development and qualification of next-generation Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) semiconductor devices for power module applications Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across R&D Design, Process Development, and Product Engineering to evaluate the performance and reliability of new technologies Plan, execute, and monitor electrical and reliability tests using advanced test equipment and methodologies Analyze test data, identify trends and root causes, and provide technical recommendations to support product development decisions. Prepare and present test reports, communicating key findings and risks to project stakeholders Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the testing laboratory, enhancing efficiency, quality, and testing capabilities Enure compliance with safety, environmental, cleanliness, and laboratory operating standards in all testing activities   Your background   Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in the semiconductor, power electronics, or related industry, ideally within electrical testing, validation, or reliability engineering Strong understanding of semiconductor devices, particularly Silicon Carbide (SiC) and\/or Silicon (Si) technologies Experience with test systems, measurement equipment, and data analysis methodologies Programming or automation skills are highly desirable, preferably in Python, LabVIEW, or similar tools Experience with statistical data analysis and engineering software tools; CAD knowledge is considered a plus Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and collaborative working style Fluent in English; German is an advantage   More about us     The opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies that enable the global energy transition Collaboration with highly skilled experts in an international and innovative environment Challenging projects with real impact on future power electronics solutions Flexible working arrangements and attractive development opportunities within a global technology leader

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro

L'opportunità di unirsi al nostro team di valutazione e qualificazione dei prodotti presso i semiconduttori Hitachi Energy a Lenzburg, dove garantiamo i più elevati standard di qualità e affidabilità per i chip e i moduli di potenza a semiconduttori di nuova generazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:

Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours.
