Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant qu'ingénieur de service sur le terrain chez HITACHI ENERGY LTD, vous êtes responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance et de la réparation de nos produits et systèmes directement chez le client en Suisse. Vous assurez la performance optimale et la disponibilité des systèmes et ainsi apporter une contribution significative à la satisfaction de nos clients. Vous pouvez y parvenir en effectuant des installations, la mise en service, l'entretien et la réparation de produits et systèmes HITACHI ENERGY, en particulier dans les domaines de la haute tension, de la transmission et de la distribution d'énergie. Analyse des erreurs et correction des équipements et systèmes électriques complexes. Création de rapports de service et de documents après chaque déploiement. Conseiller les clients sur les questions techniques et les options d'optimisation. formation du personnel client à la manipulation des installations. Conformité aux normes de sécurité et de qualité. Volonté de voyager en Suisse et occasionnellement à l'étranger. Participation au service de garde en dehors des heures normales de travail. Formation continue et mise à jour des compétences en matière de nouveaux produits et technologies. Votre formation Formation technique terminée (p. ex. électricien, ingénieur en électronique, automatiste) ou études (p. ex. génie électrique, génie énergétique). Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du service ou de la maintenance des systèmes électriques, idéalement dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Une connaissance approfondie de la technologie à haute tension, des systèmes de commutation et de commande est avantageuse. Utilisation sécuritaire de l'équipement de mesure et d'essai. Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture (l'allemand suisse est un avantage), ainsi que bonne connaissance de l'anglais. La connaissance du français est un atout. Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et en pensée analytique. Un degré élevé d'initiative, de responsabilité et d'orientation des clients. Catégorie de permis de conduire valide B. Volonté de travailler des heures flexibles et de voyager. Plus sur nous
• Nous offrons passionnant et varié
• Tâches avec une grande marge de manœuvre créative ainsi que des possibilités attrayantes de formation et de développement. Vous pouvez vous attendre à des activités et des projets intéressants et diversifiés, y compris des opérations offshore, une équipe bien établie et dynamique et une culture d'entreprise ouverte. De plus, vous bénéficiez d'un service attrayant avec des forfaits de voyage et de nourriture fixes ainsi que d'un mot pour dire dans le choix de l'hébergement.

jobs.title: Teamleiter/in Elektromontage 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Teamleiter\/in Elektromontage in der GI Valves Fabrik in Seon bzw. Turgi leitest Du ein Team von ca. 15 Mitarbeitenden. Dabei übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeitenden und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit (ca. 50%).   Das kannst du bewirken Leitung des Teams sowohl fachlich und operativ als auch personell Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Umsetzung und Durchsetzung der übergeordneten Organisationsziele   Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Weiterbildung als Techniker HF von Vorteil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Teamleiter\/in und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen (MES) sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: Riguardo alla posizione di team leader / in assemblaggio elettrico presso la fabbrica GI Valves di Seon o Turgi conduce un team di circa 15 dipendenti. Si assume un ruolo centrale nel controllo quotidiano della produzione. Coordinate le attività operative all'interno del team e assicurate che i processi di assemblaggio, collaudo e logistica siano efficienti, sicuri e di qualità. Sei la persona di contatto diretto per i dipendenti e lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione della produzione e altre interfacce. Il vostro impegno contribuisce in modo significativo al raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi di produzione e al continuo miglioramento. Oltre alle attività coordinate, siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di assemblaggio (circa il 50%). È possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo guidando il team sia professionalmente che operativamente, sia l'organizzazione del personale e il monitoraggio dei processi di produzione (assembly, testing, logistics) il rispetto della sicurezza, della qualità e delle specifiche ambientali Supporta la formazione di nuovi dipendenti e l'attuazione della formazione di sicurezza Cooperazione con interfacce come la pianificazione, la qualità e la logistica, nonché la documentazione delle prestazioni di produzione Questo ti porta con formazione professionale tecnica (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, installazione elettrica, meccatronica) ulteriore formazione come tecnico HF di vantaggio Diversi anni di esperienza nell'assemblaggio di componenti elettrotecnici Esperienza come team leader e buone capacità di comunicazione Tedesco in parola e scrittura, competenze in inglese di vantaggio SAP conoscenza e esperienza con sistemi di produzione digitale (MES) sono un plus Maggiori informazioni su di noi I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le vostre prestazioni personali e professionali, e creare un ambiente digitale
descriptionByLocale.en: About the position as team leader / in electrical assembly at the GI Valves factory in Seon or Turgi leads a team of about 15 employees. You take on a central role in daily production control. You coordinate operational activities within the team and ensure that assembly, testing and logistics processes are efficient, safe and quality-appropriate. You are the direct contact person for the employees and work closely with production management and other interfaces. Your commitment contributes significantly to achieving our production goals and continuously improving. In addition to coordinative activities, you are actively involved in the assembly process (about 50%). jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity As Area Sales Manager, you will drive market penetration and profitable growth for our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) Service portfolio. You'll lead and empower local sales teams, foster customer relationships, and leverage on digital tools to deliver exceptional service and results. Our Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of GCB and GIS systems for both Transmission (220kV-550kV) and Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV) level, including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, value-added services, troubleshooting, modification, retrofits and replacements. You have a higher education with a technical and\/or commercial focus? You have profound sales experience and service mindset with strong negotiation skills? You are highly experienced in working closely together with customers from different countries, you understand their requirements and you can handle any complaints or issues? You have self-motivation and persistence as well as a service-mindset? Then we have the right opportunity for you! How you'll make an impact Define and execute go-to-market strategies together with local service sales teams, channel partners, and service organizations to drive sustainable order growth Lead proactive sales and marketing activities for maintenance and service solutions while optimizing regional pricing strategies and increasing market penetration Analyze installed base data, market dynamics, and customer needs to develop sales action plans and grow the maintenance sales pipeline Build strong customer and partner relationships, provide consultative support, and enable local service sales teams through product and service knowledge sharing Manage the entire service project offer process, from opportunity identification and quotation preparation through contract negotiation and handover to execution Utilize digital tools, CRM systems, and sales analytics to ensure data quality, maintain accurate forecasts, and improve customer experience Monitor business performance against targets, identify gaps, develop annual order budgets, and implement actions to achieve growth objectives Mentor and support service sales teams at Product Service Center and Local Service Unit, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and drive enhancements of sales processes and tools Your background Degree in a technical or commercial discipline Proven experience in sales, business development, or account management within the energy, industrial, or infrastructure sector Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with a track record of delivering results Customer-focused approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across diverse markets and cultures Experience with Salesforce, SAP, and other digital sales tools Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills Self-motivated, resilient, and driven to create business opportunities Fluent in English; additional languages such as Spanish are a plus Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package Hitachi Energy is able to offer you an interesting role within a highly motivated team, together with open communica

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabile Vendite Area

Responsabilità

- Definire e eseguire strategie di lancio sul mercato insieme alle squadre di vendita locale, ai partner di canale e alle organizzazioni di servizio per stimolare la crescita degli ordini sostenibili

- Guidare attività di vendita e marketing proattive per soluzioni di manutenzione e servizio, ottimizzando strategie di prezzo regionali e aumentando la penetrazione di mercato

- Analizzare i dati dell'installazione, le dinamiche del mercato e le esigenze dei clienti per sviluppare piani di azione di vendita e crescere la pipeline di vendita di manutenzione

- Costruire forti relazioni con i clienti e i partner, fornire supporto consulenziale e abilitare le squadre di vendita locale condividendo conoscenze di prodotti e servizi

- Gestire l'intero processo di offerta di servizio, dalla identificazione delle opportunità e la preparazione della proposta di prezzo alla negoziazione del contratto e alla consegna all'esecuzione

- Utilizzare strumenti digitali, sistemi CRM e analisi di vendita per garantire la qualità dei dati, mantenere previsioni accurate e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente

- Monitorare le prestazioni commerciali rispetto agli obiettivi, identificare le lacune, sviluppare budget annuali di ordini e implementare azioni per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita

- Guidare e supportare le squadre di vendita di servizio al Centro di Servizio dei Prodotti e all'Unità di Servizio Locale, promuovere una cultura di miglioramento continuo e stimolare l'innovazione dei processi di vendita e delle attrezzature

Requisiti

- Laurea in una disciplina tecnica o commerciale

- Esperienza provata in vendita, sviluppo aziendale o gestione di conto all'interno del settore energetico, industriale o di infrastrutture

- Solida conoscenza commerciale e abilità di negoziazione con un record di consegne di risultati

- Approccio centrato sul cliente e la capacità di costruire relazioni fiduciarie in diversi mercati e culture

- Esperienza con Salesforce, SAP e altri strumenti di vendita digitali

- Solide abilità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione dei stakeholder

- Motivato, resiliente e determinato a creare opportunità commerciali

- Fluenza in inglese; lingue aggiuntive come lo spagnolo sono un plus

- Disponibilità a viaggiare internazionalmente fino al 50%

Cosa offriamo

- Un ambiente che favorisce la collaborazione, la connessione e la diversità di pensiero

- Una cultura unica: venite come siete e portate le vostre unicità, la vostra passione e la vostra determinazione al design e alla gestione dei Pensions & Benefits a Hitachi Energy

- Lavoro flessibile, compreso l'opportunità di lavorare in modalità ibrida/da remoto

- Pacchetto di compensazione e benefici competitivo

- Ruolo interessante all'interno di una squadra motivata, con comunicazione aperta e opportunità di crescita e sviluppo

Contatti

- Abbiamo l'opportunità giusta per voi se avete una formazione universitaria con un focus tecnico e/o commerciale, esperienza di vendita profonda e mentalità di servizio con abilità di negoziazione solide, motivazione e persistenza, e mentalità di servizio.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Vertriebsleiter Bereich

Aufgaben

- Definieren und umsetzen von Markteintrittsstrategien zusammen mit lokalen Vertriebsvertriebsmannschaften, Kanalpartnern und Serviceorganisationen, um nachhaltige Bestellwachstum zu fördern

- Leiten proaktive Vertriebs- und Marketingaktivitäten für Wartungs- und Serviceangebote, während regionale Preisstrategien optimieren und den Marktanteil erhöhen

- Analysieren installierte Basisdaten, Marktdynamiken und Kundenbedürfnisse, um Vertriebsaktionen zu entwickeln und die Wartungsvertriebspipeline zu wachsen

- Aufbauen starker Kunden- und Partnerbeziehungen, bereitstellen konsultativer Unterstützung und ermöglichen lokalen Vertriebsmannschaften durch Produkt- und Servicekenntnisse

- Verwalten des gesamten Serviceprojektangebots, von der Identifizierung von Chancen und der Vorbereitung von Angeboten bis hin zur Verhandlung von Verträgen und der Übergabe an die Ausführung

- Nutzen digitale Werkzeuge, CRM-Systeme und Vertriebsanalysen, um Datenqualität sicherzustellen, genaue Vorhersagen zu erhalten und die Kundenfreundlichkeit zu verbessern

- Überwachen Geschäftsergebnisse gegenüber Zielen, identifizieren Lücken, entwickeln jährliche Bestellbudgets und implementieren Maßnahmen, um Wachstumsziele zu erreichen

- Mentoren und unterstützen Vertriebsmannschaften am Produkt-Service-Zentrum und am lokalen Serviceeinheit, fördern eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und treiben Verbesserungen der Vertriebssysteme und -werkzeuge

Anforderungen

- Abschluss in einer technischen oder kaufmännischen Disziplin

- Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Unternehmensentwicklung oder Kundenbeziehungen im Energie-, Industrie- oder Infrastruktursektor

- Solide kaufmännische Kenntnisse und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit einem Erfolgsrekord

- Kundenorientierter Ansatz und die Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen in verschiedenen Märkten und Kulturen aufzubauen

- Erfahrung mit Salesforce, SAP und anderen digitalen Vertriebswerkzeugen

- Solide Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten

- Selbstmotiviert, resilient und bestrebt, Geschäftschancen zu schaffen

- Englisch fließend; zusätzliche Sprachen wie Spanisch sind ein Plus

- Bereitschaft, international zu reisen, bis zu 50%

Was wir bieten

- Ein Umfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Verbindung und Vielfalt des Denkens fördert

- Eine einzigartige Kultur: Kommt wie ihr seid und bringt eure einzigartige Attribute, Leidenschaft und Energie zum Design und zur Verwaltung von Pensions- und Benefits bei Hitachi Energy

- Flexible Arbeitszeit, einschließlich Hybrid- oder Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten

- Ein attraktives Angebot an Vergütung und Benefits

- Ein interessantes Projekt innerhalb einer motivierten Mannschaft, mit offener Kommunikation und Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und zum Wachstum

Kontakt

- Wir haben die richtige Gelegenheit für euch, wenn ihr eine Hochschulbildung mit einem technischen und/oder kaufmännischen Schwerpunkt habt, eine tiefgreifende Vertriebserfahrung und eine Dienstleistungsmentalität mit solider Verhandlungsfähigkeit habt, Selbstmotivation und Ausdauer sowie eine Dienstleistungsmentalität.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Responsable des ventes région

Tâches

- Définir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de lancement sur le marché avec les équipes de vente locale, les partenaires de canal et les organisations de service pour stimuler la croissance des commandes durables

- Diriger des activités de vente et de marketing proactives pour les solutions de maintenance et de service, tout en optimisant les stratégies de prix régionales et en augmentant la pénétration de marché

- Analyser les données de la base d'installation, les dynamiques du marché et les besoins des clients pour développer des plans d'action de vente et faire croître la pipeline de vente de maintenance

- Construire des relations solides avec les clients et les partenaires, fournir un soutien consultatif et permettre aux équipes de vente locale de partager des connaissances de produits et de services

jobs.title: Internship in Large-Scale Software Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in software engineering, software architecture, or data processing and visualization to contribute to the development of a novel framework for variability management in large-scale software systems. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support technology development and research activities related to the design and architecture of industrial software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software systems via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background Enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science or a related field (Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering) Strong background in software engineering, software architecture, and\/or data engineering Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) is strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Definirai soluzioni tecniche, guiderai sforzi ingegneristici attraverso sistemi di distribuzione MV & LV e apparecchiature di conversione dell'energia e collaborerai con stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'innovazione e l'eccellenza.

Se sei appassionato di mobilità sostenibile e prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce, questa è la tua occasione per avere un impatto reale.

Come farete un impatto - Prendete il comando tecnico nell'esecuzione e nella gara d'appalto di progetti di infrastrutture elettriche eMobility (ad esempio, depositi di autobus, stazioni di ricarica dei terminali), supporto e guida Team di esecuzione e gara d'appalto locali - Disponi di tutte le attività di ingegneria attraverso cicli di vita dei progetti.dalla progettazione alla messa in servizio - al 21a livello interno con unità operative locali responsabili dell'esecuzione e della gara d'appalto, Vendite, R&D, ingegneri dei prodotti, catena di approvvigionamento, team di installazione e messa in servizio del sito e esternamente con clienti, fornitori - Coordinare e supervisionare team di ingegneria a distanza per

attività di ingegneria primaria e secondaria applicabili - Progettazione architetture del sistema di alimentazione, esecuzione di calcoli di sizing e preparazione delle specifiche tecniche - Evaluate provider offre e supporta i processi di approvvigionamento con Supply Chain Management - Fornire competenze tecniche durante le fasi di gara e di esecuzione dei progetti - Tradurre i requisiti dei clienti in soluzioni tecniche ottimizzate e conformi - Lead discussioni tecniche con i clienti, risolvere le query del sito e garantire risultati tempestivi e di alta qualità - Garantire la sicurezza, la conformità e l'eccellenza ingegneristica durante tutto il progetto

Il vostro background - Laurea o laurea magistrale in ingegneria elettrica, con un focus su Power Electronics o Power Systems - 7.10 anni di esperienza in sistemi di distribuzione di energia MV/LV, progettazione e ingegneria di sistemi elettrici - Esperienza con sistemi di alimentazione CC, convertitori di potenza, stoccaggio di energia o filtraggio armonico è un plus - Forte conoscenza di strumenti e software ingegneristici (ad esempio, BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) - Proattivo, mentalità basata sui risultati con forti competenze di lavoro di squadra e comunicazione - Impegnato per la sicurezza, la qualità e l'apprendimento continuo - Volontà di viaggiare fino al 10% per

incontri con i clienti e i progetti - Fluente in inglese e francese

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Drive the BU supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and business alignment. Monitor sustainability trends, regulations, and customer requirements, integrating them into plans and processes. Standardize material sustainability processes and ensure effective implementation across the supply chain. Lead sustainability improvement initiatives, including decarbonization and supplier engagement. Track sustainability performance and drive continuous improvement through data-driven insights. Develop and maintain material sustainability data, enabling consistent LCA, EPD, and PCF assessments. Partner with suppliers and stakeholders to advance emission reduction and sustainable practices. Deliver training and promote best practices across the SCM community. Align and apply methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving standards. Support supplier requirements, material selection, environmental claims, and customer sustainability requests Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels. titleByLocale.fr: Responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux MSC (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers per unire il nostro team innovativo e avanzato. In questo ruolo, guiderai la gestione end-to-end del pilastro Sostenibilità dei Materiali, allineando le metodologie per la valutazione dell'impatto ambientale, definendo i processi, implementando iniziative e monitorando i progressi nell'unità aziendale. Questa è la tua opportunità di allineare con gli obiettivi aziendali e i requisiti normativi, sostenere gli obiettivi di sostenibilità dell'organizzazione e fare un impatto significativo nel settore dell'energia. Guidare la strategia di sostenibilità della supply chain BU, concentrandosi sulla sostenibilità dei materiali e sull'allineamento degli affari. Monitorare le tendenze, le normative e i requisiti dei clienti, integrandoli in piani e processi. Standardizzare i processi di sostenibilità dei materiali e garantire un'efficace attuazione in tutta la supply chain. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento della sostenibilità, tra cui decarbonizzazione e coinvolgimento dei fornitori. Traccia le prestazioni di sostenibilità e migliora continuamente attraverso le informazioni basate sui dati. Sviluppare e mantenere i dati di sostenibilità dei materiali, consentendo valutazioni LCA, EPD e PCF coerenti. Partner con fornitori e stakeholder per promuovere la riduzione delle emissioni e pratiche sostenibili. Fornire formazione e promuovere le migliori pratiche in tutta la comunità SCM. Allineare e applicare metodologie per la valutazione degli impatti ambientali materiali in linea con gli standard in evoluzione.
• Requisiti dei fornitori di supporto, selezione dei materiali, reclami ambientali e richieste di sostenibilità dei clienti La vostra laurea in Scienze Ambientali, Ingegneria, Gestione della Supply Chain, o un campo relativo. Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione della supply chain con particolare attenzione alla sostenibilità, con una consolidata leadership nella creazione di strategia e roadmap, preferibilmente all'interno di organizzazioni globali o su larga scala. Forte competenza in materia di standard di sostenibilità dei materiali come ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, il Greenhouse Gas Protocol e le relative strutture. Ampia esperienza con Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), e l'implementazione di programmi di sostenibilità globale relativi a materiali e fornitori. Forte capacità di leadership con un track record di sviluppo ed esecuzione di iniziative strategiche in ambienti complessi e internazionali. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di costruire relazioni e ispirare il cambiamento a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un luogo di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme. Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione in località specificata: Italia: a partire da 62.200 EUR lordo salario annuo L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne. Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva. La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e generalmente include: stipendio competitivo e incentivi Benessere e cura Lasciare a pagamento e non pagati Opzioni di lavoro flessibili Vantaggi che sostengono la vostra sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi Energy sucht einen Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead für die Business Unit Transformers, um sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anzuschließen. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie das End-to-End-Management der Säule Materialnachhaltigkeit, richten Methoden für Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen aus, definieren Prozesse, implementieren Initiativen und überwachen den Fortschritt in der gesamten Geschäftseinheit. Dies ist Ihre Chance, sich an Geschäftszielen und regulatorischen
• Anforderungen auszurichten, die Nachhaltigkeitsziele des Unternehmens zu unterstützen und einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf die Energiewirtschaft zu erzielen. Wie Sie Ihre Wirkung erzielen, treiben Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie der BU-Lieferkette voran, wobei Sie sich auf materielle Nachhaltigkeit und Geschäftsausrichtung konzentrieren. Überwachen Sie Nachhaltigkeitstrends, Vorschriften und Kundenanforderungen und integrieren Sie diese in Pläne und Prozesse. Standardisieren Sie Materialnachhaltigkeitsprozesse und gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Umsetzung in der gesamten Lieferkette. Leiten Sie Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Nachhaltigkeit, einschließlich Dekarbonisierung und Lieferantenbindung. Verfolgen Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsleistung und fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Pflege von Material-Nachhaltigkeitsdaten, die konsistente LCA-, EPD- und PCF-Bewertungen ermöglichen. Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Stakeholdern, um die Emissionsreduzierung und nachhaltige Praktiken voranzutreiben. Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Förderung von Best Practices in der gesamten SCM-Community. Anpassung und Anwendung von Methoden zur Bewertung von wesentlichen Umweltauswirkungen im Einklang mit sich entwickelnden Normen. Unterstützung von Lieferantenanforderungen, Materialauswahl, Umweltaussagen und Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen für Kunden Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit, mit nachgewiesener Führungsrolle in der Strategie- und Roadmap-Erstellung, vorzugsweise in globalen oder großen Organisationen. Starke Expertise in Nachhaltigkeitsstandards für Materialien wie ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, dem Greenhouse Gas Protocol und verwandten Frameworks. Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) und der Umsetzung globaler Nachhaltigkeitsprogramme in Bezug auf Materialien und Lieferanten. Starke Führungsqualitäten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Initiativen in komplexen, internationalen Umgebungen. Hervorragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Veränderungen auf allen Organisationsebenen anzuregen. Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux SCM pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires de rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la gestion de bout en bout du pilier Développement durable des matériaux, en alignant les méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux, en définissant les processus, en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives et en surveillant les progrès dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle. C'est l'occasion pour vous de vous conformer aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires, de soutenir les objectifs de durabilité de l'organisation et d'avoir un impact significatif dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Comment vous ferez un impact Conduire la stratégie de durabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement BU, en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité matérielle et l'alignement des entreprises. Surveiller les tendances en matière de durabilité, les règlements et les exigences des clients, en les intégrant dans les plans et les processus. Normaliser les processus de durabilité matérielle et assurer une mise en œuvre efficace dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la durabilité, y compris la décarbonisation et l'engagement des fournisseurs. Suivre les performances en matière de durabilité et favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des données. Élaborer et tenir à jour des données sur la durabilité des matériaux, ce qui permettra d'effectuer des évaluations cohérentes de la LCA, de la DPE et de la PCF. Établir des partenariats avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants pour faire progresser la réduction des émissions et les pratiques durables. Offrir de la formation et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble de la collectivité de MSC. Aligner et appliquer des méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux matériels conformément aux normes en évolution. Soutenir les exigences des fournisseurs, la sélection des matériaux, les revendications environnementales et les demandes de durabilité des clients Diplôme en sciences de l'environnement, en génie, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité, avec un leadership prouvé dans la création de stratégies et de feuilles de route, de préférence au sein des organisations mondiales ou à grande échelle. Forte expertise en matière de normes de durabilité des matériaux, telles que ISO 14067, ISO 14044, le Protocole sur les gaz à effet de serre et les cadres connexes. jobs.title: Network and Security Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this challenging role, you will design the network and security architecture for communication networks used in power utilities, wind farms, and other critical infrastructure, based on the modern technology standards. How you'll make an impact You will develop systems in compliance with security standards such as IEC 62443 and NERC-CIP You will implement planned cybersecurity measures on devices and applications You will support the sales organization during the tender phase and in customer discussions With your technical expertise, you will assist the project manager and coordinate with both customers and internal stakeholders You will prepare procedures and operational manuals tailored to customer requirements You will conduct risk assessments as part of project execution, in alignment with IEC 62443, to identify and evaluate cybersecurity risks within industrial automation systems and ensure appropriate security measures are implemented Your background You have a degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or equivalent professional experience, along with experience in communication networks and system architectures in industrial or infrastructure environments You are proficient in cybersecurity technologies, LAN\/WAN networks, peripheral devices, and operating systems including MS Windows (Server, AD) and Linux You demonstrate strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to work independently Excellent command of English is required You are motivated to help build a new business area and actively support the transition to a cybersecure work approach, assisting engineers in adopting cybersecurity best practices More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. jobs.title: Internship in Dielectric Withstand of Gas Insulated Switchgear 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. This role offers hands-on experience with simulations, measurements, and cutting-edge dielectric tools. You will learn from experienced mentors while taking ownership of meaningful tasks. The position supports continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. How you'll make an impact Support development of SF6-free high-voltage circuit breakers through simulations and testing Perform electric field simulations to support dielectric design decisions Analyze and evaluate breakdown measurements and test results Maintain and expand breakdown databases including alternative gases Use and further develop internally established dielectric evaluation tools Contribute to design optimization through simulation insights and basic testing Collaborate with interdisciplinary project teams in circuit breaker development Conduct literature research on breakdown and flashover phenomena and extract relevant data including simulations (Comsol) Your background Enrolled Student (preferably Master) or Graduate in Physics, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Strong programming skills and interest in Python, Matlab, or Excel Fluent in written and spoken English Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills Ability to work collaboratively and take initiative independently Interest in high-voltage systems and simulation-based engineering (Comsol, CAD, Creo) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. jobs.description: The opportunity   We are looking for a Project Manager for Secondary Engineering to join our team. jobs.title: Tendering Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable​ energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. You will join a collaborative and diverse team shaping innovative transformer solutions. As a Tendering Engineer you create preliminary design cost estimations for dry type transformers plus inductors according to customer specifications. A secondary objective is to provide sales and customers with technical support and act as a link between sales and engineering.   
• Your responsibilities Review customer specifications to define technical tender requirements Develop deviation sheets and propose suitable technical solutions Create accurate cost estimates and define material requirements in ERP and define material requirements Obtain accurate pricing information by collaborating with suppliers & vendors Ensure on-time cost estimate submittal to the bid and proposal team Maintaining accurate technical and costing product information throughout the entire deal lifecycle Provide technical tender support during bid revision or negotiation Ensure clear and timely communication with all tender stakeholders Your background University Degree in Electrical or Mechanical engineering First experience in a similar role, especially in regard to the technical skills Experience in CAD and Microsoft 365 tools Strong attention to detail and communication skills as well as a self-starter mentality Fluent in English, Italian would be beneficial Willingness to travel up to 10% More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Come Ingegnere di Tendering crei stime preliminari dei costi di progettazione per trasformatori di tipo secco più induttori secondo le specifiche del cliente. Un obiettivo secondario è quello di fornire vendite e clienti con supporto tecnico e agire come un collegamento tra vendite e ingegneria.

descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. You will leverage your technical expertise to lead key aspects of projects, ensuring that solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance while adhering to strict deadlines and budgets. jobs.title: Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, you help define how future power systems will be planned, built, and operated. As Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis, you play a key role in shaping the company's perspective on the global energy transition. Within the Market Innovation function and the Power Systems of the Future research program, you lead complex analytical work at the intersection of long‑term system planning, market design, and detailed technical grid analysis. You translate disruptive trends such as, renewables, electrification, sector coupling, inverter‑based resources into robust scenarios, advanced models, and actionable insights. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical professional who combines deep analytical expertise with strategic thinking, software proficiency, and the ability to influence peers, stakeholders, and future technology directions. How you'll make an impact Lead development of medium‑ and long‑term energy transition scenarios Analyze impacts of electrification, hydrogen, storage, and market design Translate policy, technology, and climate drivers into modeling assumptions Advance capacity expansion and system planning methodologies and tools Improve optimization formulations, algorithms, and computational workflows Perform advanced power system studies, including dynamics and fault analysis Assess integration of inverter‑based resources and grid‑forming controls Bridge strategic planning models with detailed technical network studies Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or similar; or MSc with 3+ years of relevant professional experience Deep expertise in energy system modeling and scenario analysis Strong knowledge of mathematical optimization and advanced simulations Proven experience with steady‑state, dynamic, and short‑circuit studies Solid understanding of converter‑dominated and inverter‑based resources Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB\/Simulink Hands‑on experience with tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, or PSCAD Ability to mentor others and contribute to technical leadership More About Us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative R&D team shaping high voltage technologies. You will contribute to the simulation and analysis of thermo-fluid phenomena relevant to switching performance and thermal behavior in gas circuit breakers. The work combines numerical simulation, data analysis, and engineering evaluation, supporting ongoing product development activities. You will work in a multidisciplinary R&D environment and collaborate with experienced engineers and researchers in the field of high-voltage technology. Bring your curiosity and make an impact from day one. The duration of the internship is 6 - 12 months. How you'll make an impact Setup and run 2D and 3D CFD simulations Perform thermo-fluid simulations using ANSYS Fluent Analyze and evaluate simulation and experimental data Post-process results using internal engineering tools Collaborate on improving simulation models and approaches Support product development through engineering insights Document simulation setups and key findings Contribute ideas to enhance performance and design Your background Enrolled in Bachelor or Master or done with studies in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or similar field Knowledge of computational fluid dynamics and thermal management Familiarity with CAD tools and experience using ANSYS Fluent Programming skills in Python or MATLAB Strong English communication skills and team-oriented mindset Willingness to handle responsibilities independently More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Gas Insulation for High Voltage (f/m/d)

jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Avrete l'opportunità di migliorare i processi produttivi esistenti e di condurre progetti di sviluppo innovativi, con particolare attenzione all'assemblaggio e alla saldatura automatizzati di chip. Nos produits comprennent des thyristors, des diodes, des thyristors à interrupteur de porte, des thyristors intégrés à interrupteur de porte, des transistors bipolaires à orifice isolé et des transistors à effet de champ à semi-conducteur métallique-oxyde. Ces composants sont fiables dans tous les secteurs comme le transport et la distribution d'électricité, la mobilité et les énergies renouvelables pour leur qualité et leur fiabilité exceptionnelles. jobs.title: Field Service Technician Power Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Transformers After Sales team in Zürich, Switzerland, and play a hands-on role in powering the nation! As a key player, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining and enhancing the reliability and longevity of power transformers all across Switzerland. In this role, you'll directly impact the stability of the Swiss electrical grid and get the unique opportunity to work alongside leading companies in the Swiss energy sector.  Every day, you'll tackle new technical challenges, ensure the safe and high-quality execution of critical fieldwork, and proudly represent Hitachi Energy's reputation for technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Step into a position where your expertise truly makes a difference!    How you´ll make an impact Apply and enforce Hitachi Energy safety standards during all onsite operations.  Perform installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, inspections, and overhauls on power transformers in accordance with internal procedures.  Plan, coordinate and optimize field interventions to ensure efficiency and quality.  Identify potential service opportunities and communicate them to the Sales team.  Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, suppliers and other stakeholders, ensuring clear descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi! Come farete un impatto Assicuratevi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti. Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. Analizzare i dati di processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla propria responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Treten Sie einem leistungsstarken Fotolithografie-Team bei, in dem Ihre Expertise wirklich Wirkung zeigt. Als Senior Photolithography Engineer sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Photolithographieprozessen in der Halbleiterfertigung verantwortlich. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, mit fortschrittlichen Lithografiegeräten zu arbeiten, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und qualitativ hochwertige Produktionsstandards zu gewährleisten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, technische Entscheidungen zu gestalten, zu langfristigen Werkzeugstrategien beizutragen und sinnvolle Verbesserungen in Bezug auf Stabilität, Betriebszeit und Prozessleistung voranzutreiben. Sind Sie jemand, der Verantwortung übernimmt, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeiht und es genießt, echte Auswirkungen zu erzielen? Heute bewerben! Wie Sie einen Einfluss erzielen Sicherstellen, dass Prozesse das Produktionsprogramm und die Ertragsziele erfüllen und alle Produkterträge und Nacharbeitsprobleme angehen. Engagieren Sie sich mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialanbietern, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. Entwickeln Sie neue Techniken, ändern Sie bestehende Designs und koordinieren Sie Prozessverbesserungsprojekte. Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu erkennen, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (Implementieren und regelmäßige Überprüfung von SPC). Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzen, Diffusion, Metallen, Trockenätzen und Implantatteams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten. Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, z. B. um CD und Overlay zu messen. Bereitschaftsdienste an Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie ab der Produktion erforderlich) mit Teilnahme an der Bereitschaftssitzung (vor dem Bereitschaftsdienst) in eigener Verantwortung mit den anderen Bereitschaftsdienstanbietern vereinbart. Ihr Hintergrund-Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrik, Mechanik, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Wafer-Photolithographie-Operationen insbesondere in Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Fertigungsumgebung (Dünnfilmkopf, Halbleiterwaferherstellung) Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Wafer-Fabrik-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Erfahrung mit Datenextraktion, -manipulation und -analyse Ein starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie Die Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. En tant qu'ingénieur principal en photolithographie, vous serez responsable du développement et de l'optimisation des processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. C'est l'occasion pour vous d'élaborer des décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'apporter des améliorations significatives à la stabilité, à la disponibilité et au rendement des processus. Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Comment vous ferez un impact Assurez-vous que les processus répondent aux objectifs du programme de production et de rendement et qu'ils traitent de tout problème de rendement et de retravail. Mobiliser les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. Analyser les données de processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'écharpe humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'écharpe sèche et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. Prend en charge certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire mesurer CD et Overlay. Les services de garde le week-end et les jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec la participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres fournisseurs de services de garde. Votre formation Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou Ph.D. avec expérience de l'industrie Expérience étendue dans les opérations de photolithographie de wafer, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition à Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication de wafer (fin-film, fabrication de wafer semi-conducteur) Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données Une bonne compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion La compétence en data science et en programmation est préférée Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

This is achieved through the continuous development of our core technologies and the continuous improvement of our processes – supported by open cooperation and a strong team spirit. Together, you ensure the reliable function of all production plants and technical systems in a highly automated process production. You actively shape the further development of maintenance – both strategically and operationally – working closely and in partnership with the management and other areas.
