jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un Service Sales Engineer per la nostra Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, a Ginevra (Svizzera). Segnalando a Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita nell'area assegnata. Sarete parte del Team Vendite che si concentra sul Servizio Trasformatore Trazione in Europa. In qualità di Service Sales Engineer è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e servizi ferroviari per le apparecchiature di rotolamento stock. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per le apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se sei un ingegnere altamente qualificato e motivato che cerca di unirsi a un team dinamico, ti invitiamo a applicare. Sostenere il team di vendita e i clienti in tutto il processo di vendita, sviluppando al tempo stesso nuovi e esistenti business aumentando la conoscenza interna ed esterna dei prodotti e del mercato Preparazione dell'offerta tecnica in conformità con il portafoglio unità e la necessità del cliente. Rivendicare gli aspetti tecnici e commerciali dell'offerta Partecipando alle discussioni sulla strategia di vendita, assegnando obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine e negoziando i vari budget di vendita del Gruppo di prodotti e piani di marketing Identificare le esigenze dei clienti e le offerte dei concorrenti attraverso l'analisi del mercato, assicurando un'efficace azione di marketing e comunicazione dimostra la proposizione di valore dei prodotti, sistemi, servizi e pacchetti La tua laurea di primo livello in ingegneria e più di 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite dirette e delle vendite La conoscenza del mercato delle ferrovie e dei clienti ferroviari (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing) è un vantaggio Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione del conto e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi Comprensione di preparazione dell'offerta, negoziazione del contratto, gestione del rischio e termini commerciali e legali Viaggiare principalmente all'interno dell'Unione Europea se necessario. I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager Sie werden die Verkaufsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses in dem zugewiesenen Bereich unterstützen. Sie werden Teil des Verkaufsteams sein, das sich auf Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, die nachhaltige Mobilitätswende durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienendienstleistungsportfolio für Fahrzeuge zu ermöglichen. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kollegen zusammen, die über langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der On-Board-Traktionstransformatoren-Services für Fahrzeuge verfügen. Mit Sitz in Genf übernimmt die Rolle Verantwortung für die Bahnkunden in Europa (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften). Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie Einfluss darauf haben, das Verkaufsteam und die Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu unterstützen, während Sie neues und bestehendes Geschäft entwickeln, indem Sie das interne und externe Wissen über Produkte und den Markt erweitern. Klären der technischen und kommerziellen Aspekte des Angebots Teilnahme an Verkaufsstrategie Diskussionen, Zuweisung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele und Verhandlungen der verschiedenen Produktgruppe Verkaufsbudgets und Marketingpläne Identifizierung der Kundenbedürfnisse und Konkurrenzangebote durch Marktanalyse, Gewährleistung effizienter Marketingaktionen und Kommunikationen zeigen das Wertversprechen der Produkte, Systeme, Service und Pakete Unterstützung des Bereichs Verkaufsorganisation / Kunden bei der Bestimmung der technisch angemessensten und kosteneffektivsten Lösungen und Bereitstellung von technischem Support, Produktpräsentationen und Produkt / Lösung / Service-bezogenes Training Übernahme der Verantwortung für spezifische Kundenfälle, um eine effiziente Lösung von Kundenproblemen zu gewährleisten und die zukünftige Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen Durchführung von Verkaufsleistungsüberprüfungen, Vorschlag von Wiederherstellungsplänen in Fällen von möglichen Auftragslücken und Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Verkaufsaktivitäten Berichte zur Unterstützung bei der Produktionsplanung Leben Kernwerte der Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Handlungen zu übernehmen, während Sie sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse des Schienenfahrzeugmarktes und der Schienenkunden (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften) sind ein Vorteil, der sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich fließend Französisch und Englisch spricht. Andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Kontoverwaltung und Cross-Selling über Systeme, Lösungen, Produkte und Dienstleistungskategorien Verständnis der Angebotsvorbereitung, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement und kommerzielle und rechtliche Begriffe Reisen vor allem innerhalb der Europäischen Union, wenn nötig. Häufige Interaktion mit Bahnkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre Unité Service Transformateurs de Traction, à Genève (Suisse). Relevant du Service de Traction Sales and Marketing Manager, vous accompagnerez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone affectée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des ventes qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les divers budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, des systèmes, des services et des forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit\/solution\/service. Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients du rail (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience dans le développement des entreprises, la gestion des comptes et la vente croisée entre les systèmes, les solutions, les produits et les catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation des offres, de la négociation des contrats, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques Voyageant principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire. jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

L'opportunità
In questo ruolo, fungerai da esperto in materia di sicurezza riconosciuto, fornendo un supporto funzionale competente in un paese o cluster di paesi. Sarai responsabile della ricerca, dell'analisi e dell'interpretazione delle minacce alla sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero avere un impatto su dipendenti, risorse o operazioni. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'attuazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Rispondendo al responsabile della sicurezza regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con una supervisione limitata, formerai professionisti di livello inferiore e contribuirai alle decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti sulla sicurezza di esperti.

Come avrai un impatto
- Analizzare le minacce emergenti alla sicurezza nazionale e internazionale e fornire valutazioni e consigli tempestivi.
- Fornire un supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza regionali e i KPI.
- Garantire la conformità attraverso audit, ispezioni e monitoraggio dell'evoluzione della legislazione sulla sicurezza.
- Fornire consulenza esperta sulla gestione dei rischi per la sicurezza a supporto delle decisioni aziendali chiave.
- Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e il cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali.
- Coinvolgere gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni in materia di sicurezza.
- Guidare o supportare progetti relativi alla sicurezza, gestire obiettivi, risorse e reportistica.
- Coordinare resilienza organizzativa, emergenza

Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des produits [global\/régional] pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante dans [localisation]. jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch herausfordernde Stelle in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Leitung von multikulturellen Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für das Spannungslevel von 110KV – 550KV Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung der vor Ort Installation, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Einhaltung vertraglicher Termine und unter Berücksichtigung lokaler gesetzlicher Vorgaben Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort ausgeführten Arbeiten mittels Qualitätskontrolle und Beurteilung der Fähigkeiten von lokalen Hilfskräften Durchführen von Produkttraining vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation Verantwortlich für die Evaluierung von Risiken und deren Minimierung. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung Interessante und vielfältige Tätigkeiten\/Projekte – auch mit Auslandseinsätzen Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team Offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktives Leistungspaket inklusive fixer Vergütung, Reise- und Verpflegungskosten sowie Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy High Tensione Products è lo specialista riconosciuto a livello mondiale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi di interruttori a circuito generatore (GCB) e del commutatore isolato a gas (GIS) tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi aggiuntivi, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, conversioni e sostituzione. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzi il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai installazioni e manutenzione GIS in tutto il mondo. Ti offre una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale. Ciò può essere raggiunto dalla gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per sistemi di interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV – 550KV Responsabile per la riuscita dell'implementazione dell'installazione, della manutenzione e delle riparazioni in loco in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e tenendo conto dei requisiti legali locali Responsabile per la qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo di qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale ausiliario locale Performare la formazione dei prodotti sul posto sul prodotto e durante l'installazione Responsabile per la valutazione dei rischi e la loro minimizzazione. Coordinamento e istruzione della forza lavoro Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto Cooperazione attiva nel miglioramento dei processi e nell'adozione proattiva di misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività sul sito Il tuo background L'insegnamento completo nella costruzione di metalli, nel settore elettrico o automobilistico La conoscenza di base elettrotecnica è un must, elettrotecnica ulteriore formazione di vantaggio Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella zona di montaggio e messa in servizio Molto buone competenze in inglese e tedesco, almeno la disponibilità B2 alle implementazioni nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con fino all'80% di attività di viaggio Giocatore di team flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Flair per una ricerca pragmatica e non convenzionale di soluzioni con elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza
• Opportunità interessanti per l'ulteriore formazione e lo sviluppo personale Attività interessanti e diversificate\/progetti – anche con incarichi all'estero Completo e dinamico Squadre aperto Cultura aziendale Pacchetto di servizio attraente, inclusi remunerazione fissa, costi di viaggio e di cibo, nonché la partecipazione alla scelta dell'alloggio
descriptionByLocale.en:
Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products is the globally recognized specialist in energy transmission and distribution. The service unit is responsible for the worldwide after-sales support of generator circuit breaker systems (GCB) and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, conversions and replacement. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our global service team, you appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practical training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead GIS installations and maintenance around the world. It offers you a technically challenging position in a multicultural environment. This can be achieved by managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas-insulated switchgear systems for the voltage level of 110KV – 550KV Responsible for the successful implementation of on-site installation, maintenance and repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and taking into account local legal requirements Responsible for the quality of the work carried out on-site by means of quality control and assessment of the skills of local auxiliary staff Performing product training on-site on the product and during installation Responsible for the evaluation of risks and their minimization. Coordination and instruction of workforce Cost control of the resources used and regular reporting to the project management Active cooperation in process improvements and proactive taking of measures to increase efficiency of the activities on site Your background Completed teaching in the metal construction, electrical or automotive sector Electrotechnical basic knowledge is a must, electrotechnical further training of advantage At least 5 years professional experience in the assembly and commissioning area Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 willingness to national and especially international worldwide deployments with up to 80% travel activity Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional search for solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied
• Tasks with a lot of creative leeway Attractive opportunities for further education and personal development Interesting and diverse activities\/projects – also with overseas assignments Accomplished and dynamic team Open corporate culture Attractive service package including fixed remuneration, travel and food costs as well as participation in the choice of accommodation

Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di ingegnere del servizio sul campo HITACHI ENERGY LTD, sei responsabile dell'installazione, della manutenzione e della riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente al cliente in Svizzera. Garantisci le prestazioni e la disponibilità ottimali dei sistemi e quindi un contributo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti. È possibile ottenere questo risultato effettuando installazioni, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazioni su prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, soprattutto nelle aree di alta tensione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Analisi degli errori e correzione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettrici complessi. Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni distribuzione. Consultare i clienti su questioni tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione. formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione delle strutture. Rispetto alle normative di sicurezza e agli standard di qualità. Volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero. Partecipazione al servizio on-call (piket) al di fuori delle ore di lavoro regolari. Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze sui nuovi prodotti e tecnologie. Formazione tecnica completata (ad esempio elettricista, ingegnere elettronico, automatista) o studi (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica). Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del servizio o della manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore dell'energia. La conoscenza approfondita della tecnologia ad alta tensione, dei sistemi di commutazione e di controllo è vantaggiosa. Uso sicuro delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova. Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura (Swiss tedesco è un vantaggio), così come una buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio. Forte capacità di problem solving e capacità di pensiero analitico. Alto grado di iniziativa, responsabilità e orientamento del cliente. Valida patente di guida categoria B. Volontà a lavorare ore flessibili e viaggi. Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
• Offriamo emozionante e variegato
• Compiti con grande stile creativo e interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e diversificati, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un pacchetto di servizio attraente con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di cibo, nonché una voce nella scelta di alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. You can achieve this by carrying out installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and correction of complex electrical equipment and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each deployment. Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options. training of customer staff in the handling of the facilities. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automatist) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy engineering). Several years of professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry. In-depth knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is advantageous. Safe use of measuring and test equipment. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills. High degree of initiative, responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driving licence category B. Willingness to work flexible hours and travel. More about us
• We offer exciting and varied
• Tasks with great creative leeway as well as attractive further education and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and diverse activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and food packages as well as a say in the choice of accommodation.

jobs.title: Teamleader Design Engineering - Generator Circuit Breaker 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems  Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Avrete la possibilità di avere un impatto reale guidando pratiche di design di alta qualità, promuovendo metodi di lavoro unificati, e la valorizzazione del processo e dell'eccellenza della documentazione. Come farete un impatto Coach e guidare un team di progettisti CAD, assicurando la creazione, la modifica e la manutenzione di dati di ingegneria per i sistemi e i componenti del circuito-breaker generatore (dimensioni del team ca. 10 FTE) Sviluppare\/enhance\/mantenere i dati master di tutti i prodotti GCB con modelli 3D, disegni e bollette di materiali nei sistemi CAD\/PLM Esecuzione di progetti speciali, progetti di risparmio di costi e miglioramento della qualità dei prodotti Iniziare e stabilire miglioramenti del processo di progettazione Garantire una collaborazione efficiente con altre funzioni ingegneristiche, project lead e ulteriori stakeholder Contribuire alla supervisione e formazione dell' appre insieme ai consulenti di conformità del team Assponsponsabile del team Solida fondazione tecnica come senior designer o equivalente background ingegneristico Esperienza comprovata e gestione sicura degli strumenti CAD (preferibilmente Creo) Forte conoscenza di lavoro dei sistemi PLM (preferibilmente PTC Windchill), ruoli, gestione degli oggetti e processi di rilascio Esperienza in una funzione leader del team o come project manager di un team di progetto Distinguere competenze di auto-organizzazione, così come preciso, stile di lavoro indipendente Capacità di gestire la qualità, priorità temi e affidabilità

Treten Sie unserem Team von Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) bei und tragen Sie zu Produkten bei, die die Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung der Stromerzeugung weltweit prägen. In dieser Funktion leiten und unterstützen Sie ein motiviertes Team von CAD-Designern und arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, projektleitenden Lieferanten und der in Oerlikon ansässigen Fabrik über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg zusammen – von frühen Designkonzepten bis hin zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen. jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Dry Transformers 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories.  Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy serve i clienti nei settori dell'utilità, dell'industria e delle infrastrutture con soluzioni e servizi innovativi in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme a clienti e partner, pionieri delle tecnologie e consentiamo la trasformazione digitale necessaria per accelerare la transizione energetica verso un futuro neutro-carbonio. A Hitachi Energy il nostro scopo sta avanzando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Portiamo il potere nelle nostre case, scuole, ospedali e fabbriche. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale per le nostre comunità e la società. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale sulle nostre comunità e società. Come farete un impatto Vi guiderete un'analisi completa dei requisiti con i team interfunzionali per comprendere le esigenze degli utenti e i vincoli di sistema complessi, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard del settore a Hitachi Energy. Ti impegni in modo proattivo con gli stakeholder chiave per definire gli obiettivi del progetto e chiarire gli aggiornamenti, facilitando una comunicazione efficace e raccogliendo intuizioni per migliorare i risultati del progetto. Abiliterà forti relazioni con i clienti chiave, utilizzando il loro feedback per guidare il miglioramento continuo nella piattaforma di progettazione meccanica. Realizzerai nuovi prodotti in una piattaforma di progettazione meccanica che garantisce elevate prestazioni e reattività, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team R&D per superare le aspettative dei clienti. È necessario condurre un'analisi approfondita del rischio e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione per ridurre al minimo gli impatti potenziali sui tempi e budget del progetto della piattaforma di progettazione meccanica. Potrai sostenere le metodologie agili del campione organizzando sprint e retrospettive regolari per migliorare la collaborazione del team e adattarsi alle mutevoli esigenze. Potrai supervisionare i processi di test e debugging per garantire la qualità del software, utilizzando strumenti avanzati per identificare e risolvere i difetti in modo efficace. Lei agirà come esperto di materia nell'ambito di progetti, offrendo indicazioni ai colleghi. Promuovere una cultura della condivisione delle conoscenze distribuendo attivamente approfondimenti, best practice e lezioni apprese a promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione continua all'interno del team. L'utente sarà responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere Hitachi Energy valorizza la sicurezza e l'integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni mentre si prende cura dei vostri colleghi e del business. Il tuo sfondo Hai una laurea in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato. 5-10 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del design con un comprovato record di progetti di design. O un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del software all'interno dell'industria del trasformatore o un campo tecnico comparabile. Conoscenza solida della modellazione Creo (Pro\/Programma, Foglio-Metale, Tavolo famiglia, Interscambio, Relazione, Scheletro, Montaggio) La competenza avanzata nei linguaggi di programmazione come C#, Java, Python, VB, C+ o C++, con una vasta esperienza nel sfruttare i framework di sviluppo software per fornire soluzioni complesse. Conoscenza approfondita del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software (SDLC) e delle metodologie agili, con una comprovata track record di team leader efficacemente attraverso tutte le fasi di sviluppo. Eccezionale problem-solving e capacità analitiche, con la capacità di eseguire analisi completa del rischio. Capacità di portare nuove prospettive e idee innovative al processo di progettazione. Forte capacità di collaborazione con la capacità di promuovere un ambiente di innovazione e lavoro di squadra tra colleghi. Volontà di viaggiare e capacità di interagire con i colleghi in diversi fusi orari, come la posizione è Global. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy sert les clients des secteurs des services publics, de l'industrie et de l'infrastructure avec des solutions et des services innovants tout au long de la chaîne de valeur. Avec nos clients et nos partenaires, nous sommes les pionniers des technologies et nous permettons la transformation numérique nécessaire pour accélérer la transition énergétique vers un avenir neutre en carbone. Chez Hitachi Energy, notre objectif est de faire progresser un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Nous apportons le pouvoir à nos maisons, écoles, hôpitaux et usines. Rejoignez-nous et travaillez avec des gens fantastiques, tout en apprenant et en vous développant sur des projets qui ont un impact réel sur nos communautés et notre société. Rejoignez-nous et travaillez avec des gens fantastiques, tout en apprenant et en vous développant sur des projets qui ont un impact réel sur nos communautés et notre société. Comment vous ferez un impact Vous dirigerez une analyse complète des exigences avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et les contraintes complexes du système, en assurant l'alignement avec les normes de l'industrie chez Hitachi Energy. Vous vous engagerez de façon proactive auprès des principaux intervenants afin de définir les objectifs du projet et de clarifier les mises à jour, de faciliter une communication efficace et de recueillir des idées pour améliorer les résultats du projet. Vous favoriserez des relations solides avec les clients clés, en utilisant leurs commentaires pour conduire à l'amélioration continue de la plate-forme de conception mécanique. Vous mettrez en œuvre des produits nouvellement développés dans une plateforme de conception mécanique qui assure une haute performance et réactivité, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de R-D pour dépasser les attentes des clients. Vous devez effectuer une analyse approfondie des risques et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation afin de minimiser les impacts potentiels sur les calendriers et les budgets des projets de la plate-forme de conception mécanique. Vous soutiendrez les méthodologies agiles championnes en organisant régulièrement des sprints et des rétrospectives pour améliorer la collaboration d'équipe et s'adapter aux exigences changeantes. Vous superviserez les processus de test et de débogage pour garantir la qualité du logiciel, en utilisant des outils avancés pour identifier et résoudre efficacement les défauts. Vous agirez en tant qu'expert en matière de projets, offrant des conseils à vos collègues. Favoriser une culture du partage des connaissances en distribuant activement les idées, les pratiques exemplaires et les leçons apprises afin de promouvoir la collaboration et l'innovation continue au sein de l'équipe. Vous serez responsable de la conformité aux règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre Hitachi Energy, c'est valoriser la sécurité et l'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Vos antécédents Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe. 5-10 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de la conception avec une expérience éprouvée de grands projets de conception. Ou un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels dans l'industrie des transformateurs ou dans un domaine technique comparable. Connaissance approfondie de la modélisation Creo (Pro\/Programme, Feuille métallique, Table familiale, Échange, Relation, Squelette, Assemblage) Compétences avancées dans les langages de programmation tels que C#, Java, Python, VB, C+ ou C++, avec une vaste expérience dans l'exploitation de cadres de développement de logiciels pour fournir des solutions complexes. Connaissance approfondie du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC) et des méthodologies agiles, avec une expérience éprouvée de diriger efficacement les équipes pendant toutes les phases du développement. Compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'effectuer une analyse complète des risques. Capacité d'apporter de nouvelles perspectives et des idées novatrices au processus de conception. De solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de favoriser un environnement d'innovation et de travail d'équipe entre collègues. Volonté de voyager et capacité d'interagir avec des collègues dans différents fuseaux horaires, comme position est Global. Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite.
